data.explanation: This is a conditional admission offer: it only becomes binding once the university has checked your bachelor's degree documents. You need to upload a certified copy of your bachelor's certificate and your final transcript to the applicant portal by the deadline shown. If these documents don't arrive in time, the offer automatically lapses, so it's worth preparing the certified copies well in advance (certification can take time). No payment or legal remedy is involved here; if you're unsure how to get your documents certified, the university's admissions office can advise.
